name: پژوهشکدهٔ تاریخ علم دانشگاه تهران — Institute for the History of Science, University of Tehran (UTIHS portal)
notes: REGISTRY-ONLY §39 (probe 2026-11-26): the main portal of the Institute for the History of Science, University of Tehran (پژوهشکدهٔ تاریخ علم دانشگاه تهران) — a Liferay site whose valuable sections are «آموزش‌های رایگان» (free education: full-text lecture / educational texts — the §35 world survey found this one of only 6 open full-text lecture sources worldwide), «مطالب تاریخ علم» (full-text HTML articles on the history of science) and «پایان‌نامه‌ها» (thesis listings). The institute's journal (مجلهٔ تاریخ علم) is already wired DIRECTLY in §36 (search_jihs) and is NOT duplicated here. The portal itself, however, sits behind an ArvanCloud JavaScript bot wall: EVERY route answers HTTP 200 with the same ~6 KB interstitial («در حال انتقال به سایت مورد نظر هستید...» / 'Transferring to the website...', Server: ArvanCloud) that mints __arcsjs / __arcsjsc cookies from obfuscated per-request JavaScript. Routes tried: (1) the homepage and section paths (/web/guest/home, /fa, /fa/) — interstitial; (2) the portal / Liferay search routes (/web/guest/search, /o/search/v1.0/search?q=<q>) and the Liferay JSON web services (/api/jsonws) — interstitial; (3) robots.txt and sitemap.xml — the interstitial is served for them too; (4) alternate routes: http:// (redirects to the same wall), www.utihs.ut.ac.ir (connection closed without response), a Googlebot user-agent — interstitial; (5) cookie-solving: the interstitial's own JavaScript was executed in a JS engine and the minted __arcsjs / __arcsjsc cookies (fresh values on every challenge page, Max-Age 900 s) were replayed with a matching browser user-agent and Referer — the server STILL returned the interstitial, so the check binds more than the cookies (browser fingerprinting) and no keyless machine route exists for the stdlib-only engine, which cannot execute JavaScript; (6) the Wayback Machine: the closest snapshot (2026-03-04) is itself the interstitial page — the crawler was walled too — so no mirror copy exists; (7) index fallbacks: the portal's HTML lectures and articles are not indexed by Crossref / DOAJ / OpenAlex, and the institute's journal articles already reach the engine via §36 (jihs direct) and §34 (ensani). The portal stays an excellent HUMAN route — a real browser passes the wall automatically — and it is registered so its domain works as a §17 credibility signal; per the full-text-only law it is NOT wired, exactly the §26 Journal.fi precedent (anti-bot challenge page → registry-only).
